$comment: The .devflow.toml schema version this skill operates under. Vendored with the skill, so a consumer's own checkout carries the requirement its pinned skills actually impose. scripts/consumer-pin-audit.sh requires the vendored skills to agree on ONE version and the policy to declare exactly that version: a schema version names an incompatible shape, not a minimum capability level, so a set declaring two different versions is refused as indeterminate rather than resolved to either. A pre-Dev-flow-v2 skill ships no such file, which is how an unadvanced pin correctly reads as requiring nothing. Declared per skill rather than once centrally because a consumer vendors skills individually and may hold any subset of them.
